# O1SF

> O1SF is a three-week U.S. market-entry program for international founders who want to test market assumptions, learn from relevant customer feedback, and build an evidence-based path toward paying customers through online preparation and an intensive San Francisco week.

The format combines two online preparation weeks with one intensive week in San Francisco for cohorts of up to nine startups. The published price is $4,999 per company for one primary founder and 0% equity; an additional founder is $2,500. Paying customers, revenue, meetings, introductions, investment, and other market outcomes are not guaranteed. Cohort dates, venues, and official application and payment channels are not currently published.

## Program

- [O1SF overview](https://o1sf.com): Understand the program's audience, three-week format, intended working outputs, participation expectations, pricing, and outcome limitations.
- [Program structure](https://o1sf.com/program): Review the two online preparation weeks, the intensive San Francisco week, working outputs, founder fit, and participation boundaries.
- [Market validation methodology](https://o1sf.com/methodology): Follow the evidence-first loop from a falsifiable assumption through a market interaction, recorded feedback, iteration, and a measurable next action.
- [Pricing and inclusions](https://o1sf.com/pricing): Check the $4,999 company fee, $2,500 additional-founder fee, 0% equity terms, included program work, excluded travel and third-party costs, and payment limitations.
- [San Francisco week](https://o1sf.com/#san-francisco): See the planned market-testing activities and the conditional target of 10–50 relevant interactions during the in-person week.
- [Mentors, advisors, and ecosystem network](https://o1sf.com/#network): Understand the types of professional support that may be available and the site's availability, participation, sponsorship, and endorsement limits.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://o1sf.com/#faq): Find concise answers about eligibility, fees, equity, meetings, investors, travel, company formation, visas, customers, and revenue.

## Founder Resources

- [U.S. market-entry resources](https://o1sf.com/resources): Browse the practical readiness, customer-discovery, and go-to-market guides in their recommended order.
- [U.S. market-entry checklist](https://o1sf.com/resources/us-market-entry-checklist): Audit customer, buying, positioning, proof, and market-learning assumptions before committing heavily to U.S. expansion.
- [Customer discovery in the U.S.](https://o1sf.com/resources/customer-discovery-us): Plan relevant interviews, ask behavior-focused questions, separate evidence from encouragement, and turn findings into decisions.
- [U.S. go-to-market plan](https://o1sf.com/resources/us-go-to-market-plan): Build an evidence-based 3-, 6-, and 12-month roadmap with owners, metrics, thresholds, and explicit decision gates.

## Optional

- [TatianaSF program host profile](https://o1sf.com/tatianasf): Learn about O1SF's public author and program host and the evidence-first working approach behind the site.
